title: BUGFIX — generate-stats-report: gate calculation uses manual-posts not auto-delivered
rationale: In scripts/scs001/generate-stats-report.ts line 116, postsDelivered = delivered.length + telegramSent.length counts auto-delivered.jsonl (Telegram delivery events, 562 entries) + telegram-sent.jsonl (15 entries) = 577 total. This makes postsLeft = max(0, 30-577) = 0 and urgency = 'PASSED' (Gate criteria met — PROCEED). But the actual gate requires TikTok posts recorded in manual-posts.jsonl, which only has 12 entries (16 per posting-health.json). The gate-tracker correctly reads manual-posts.jsonl. Fix: replace the gate postsDelivered calculation to use manualEntries.length (actual TikTok posts).

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/generate-stats-report.ts: change line 116 from `const postsDelivered = delivered.length + telegramSent.length` to `const postsDelivered = manualEntries.length`. Add comment explaining the distinction between Telegram delivery events (auto-delivered.jsonl) and actual TikTok posts (manual-posts.jsonl).
